Firebase JS SDK 10.13.2 (compat builds), unchanged from the official npm package firebase@10.13.2
(byte-identical to https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.2/). Bundled because Chrome extensions may not load
remote code: loaded from gstatic, the scripts were blocked and the cloud features never connected in an installed build.
